resources.string: Send new measurements as JSON to your server. Leave the URL empty to turn forwarding off. Use HTTPS to protect measurements and credentials.
Keep new readings in local history
With local history off, new readings stay only in a temporary upload queue until the server accepts them. Existing history stays. Health Connect export needs local history.
Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL and a single-line Authorization value.
Some uploads have not been accepted. They will retry automatically.
Queued readings stay assigned to their original server. Changing the URL pauses uploads to the previous server.

HTTP forwarding is optional and off by default. When enabled, new measurements are sent to the server you specify. Pending uploads are stored privately until accepted. Passthrough does not add readings to local history or Health Connect. Previously saved data stays.
